## Review: FAFF-7001

### Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Signal: pass. No findings.

## Adversarial findings — NOT RUN (malformed backend configuration)

`faff adversarial-backends --consumer code_review` exited 2: `adversarial.fallbacks is not valid JSON: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1`. The review helper was not invoked and there was no fallback to the primary reviewer alone. The review returns `needs-human`.

### major: Malformed adversarial.fallbacks configuration

Location: .faffrc.yaml
The adversarial.fallbacks value is not valid JSON, so the adversarial backend chain could not be resolved and no second opinion was obtained.
Action: Correct adversarial.fallbacks to a valid JSON array of backends, then rerun Phase 2.
